title: Sophie — Compliance daypad: evidence triage + vendor quicknotes
content:
Morning brain dump (quick, messy) — work plan for today:

07:30 quick scan: inbox + slack #sec-compliance — flagged 3 items for evidence upload.

Top priorities (today)
- Evidence triage: finish mapping of access logs to control CC6 (auth logging). Need to export last 6 months of auth events for tenant-owned keys.
- Vendor questionnaire: finish draft responses for SecureStore (SIG-lite) and send to Jordan for review by EOD.
- Policy TODO: update Key Management Policy draft with new rotation cadence (90 -> 60 days) + explicit exception process.

Evidence triage notes (rough)
- Auth logs: cluster-prod -> /var/log/auth-service/ (elk ingestion confirmed). Action: pull 2025-10 -> 2026-04 by host, filter for grant/revoke events, attach sample to evidence bundle. Owner: Sophie. ETA: 2026-04-12.
- KMS keys: KMS audit trail exists but missing key-owner tags for 4 keys. Open ticket to infra to tag keys (JIRA-SEC-1123). Attach screenshot of console and anchor link in confluence.
- SAML assertions: need artifact proving IdP metadata refresh schedule — ask Platform SRE for last 3 IdP refresh timestamps. Slack ping: @lina (sre).

Vendor review quicknotes
- SecureStore (PSA vendor)
  - Completed: SOC2 attestation doc received (dated 2025-11) — good.
  - Concern: endpoint allow-list unclear; confirm data residency for EU tenants.
  - Ask: request a signed data processing addendum (DPA). Linked ask in email thread w/ procurement.

- VaultKey (key management add-on)
  - Demo notes: supports HSM-backed keys, but integration requires a nightly sync job (latency risk).
  - Action: decision matrix — cost vs latency vs control. Add to vendor shortlist doc.

Policy TODOs (short)
- Key Management Policy: change rotation to 60 days, add "emergency rotation" bullet, define exception approval flow (legal + infosec).
- Access Review cadence: move from quarterly -> monthly for high-privilege groups.
- Evidence retention: document retention periods per control (map to storage bucket TTLs).

Meetings / follow-ups
- 10:00 sync w/ Jordan (vendor responses) — bring draft SIG answers, confirm who signs DPA.
- 14:00 catch-up w/ Platform SRE (IdP refresh + SAML evidence). Prep: list of required timestamps + sample assertion.
- 16:30 unblockers touchpoint (if infra tags KMS keys by then).

Blockers (callouts)
- Infra needs to tag KMS keys before I can close control evidence. Without tags, auditors ask for owner mappings. Raised JIRA-SEC-1123 — waiting assign.
- Legal to review DPA template — procurement says 3 business days. Plan: escalate if not back by 2026-04-13.

Quick commands / data pulls (notes-to-self)
- ELK: curl -XGET "https://elk.internal/api/logs/auth-service/_search?from=2025-10-01&to=2026-04-01&filter=grant,revoke" > auth-grants.json
- GCS: gsutil cp gs://redwood-prod-audit/auth-exports/2026-*.ndjson ./evidence/
- KMS: aws kms list-keys --query "Keys[?contains(KeyId,'prod')]==`true`" — then aws kms describe-key --key-id <id> to capture tags.

Open questions (for Monday if not resolved)
- Do we accept vendor SIG-lite responses for all low-risk vendors or require full SIG for host-level services? (Ask Legal)
- For dedicated customers, are we obliged to demonstrate per-tenant log retention — or is aggregated proof sufficient? (Product / Sales input needed)

Presentation prep (for audit packet)
- Draft a 1-pager: "Auth & Key Management — evidence index" with a table of artifacts, owners, locations, and proof type. Keep it simple: auditors love one-pagers.

Notes to self (messy)
- If infra can't tag keys by EOD, attach a temporary mapping CSV showing discovery time + current owner assigned by hand and label it as "interim".
- Remember to timestamp every exported evidence file and include checksum. Example: auth-grants-20260410.sha256
- Don't forget to cc procurement on DPA emails so legal loop is visible.

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] Upload auth export sample to confluence evidence page
- [ ] Send SecureStore SIG answers to Jordan for review
- [ ] Create Key Management Policy diff and request review from Legal
- [ ] Update evidence index one-pager (first draft)

Random crumbs (useful links + refs)
- Evidence index (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.example/SOC2/evidence-index
- KMS tagging ticket: JIRA-SEC-1123
- Vendor shortlist doc (team drive): https://drive.redwood.example/drives/vendor-eval/

If I get a moment: tidy up vendor scoring matrix and mark SecureStore as P1 vs P2 based on DPA + residency.

-- Sophie

(quick note: rename file to match audit bundle naming once things are stable: evidence-bundle-<control>-v1.json)
